🎬 Every Which Way But Loose (1978)

🎬 Movie
⭐️ Genre: Action, Comedy
🎭 Starring: Clint Eastwood, Sondra Locke, Geoffrey Lewis

📝 Summary:
Every Which Way But Loose follows Philo Beddoe, a laid-back truck driver and bare-knuckle fighter who travels across the American West in search of the woman he loves. Accompanied by his loyal best friend and an orangutan named Clyde, Philo finds himself caught in a series of hilarious misadventures involving biker gangs, bounty hunters, and underground fistfights. Along the way, he discovers that loyalty and friendship matter just as much as winning.

🔥 Why Watch?

* Clint Eastwood in one of his funniest roles
* Charming mix of action and comedy
* Memorable chemistry between Philo and Clyde the orangutan
* Entertaining road-trip adventure with plenty of laughs
* A feel-good classic packed with quirky moments

🏆 Rating: 6.3/10 (IMDb)

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 54m
